title: Changes for 802.1 as 2020 1 step/master
description: 802.1 as 2020 added support for 1 step sync message and for 1 step follow up information Tlv will be appended to sync message. Added change to dissector for the same

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 0066b275 - Added changes to fix compilation issue
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2638/diffs?diff_id=168087701&start_sha=5fa122ffc276ce510b39d1e834224c7758921e5e)

added 1 commit
  • edb86a3f - Compilation Issue Fix
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2638/diffs?diff_id=168115576&start_sha=0066b275cf7751e5309cd1865dc1915a036f1660)
Can you please rebase and preferably squash the commits?
Prefer if this change was not done.
Use the pattern of the value on the same line as the define.

To me formating looks wierd, more stuff on the same line not using long define names?
In this case using actual numbers may be more readable?

There is a lot of stuff mixed up in this MR:
- gPTP/802.1AS-2020 update to support the FollowUp-TLV in 1-step sync --> https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/5825
- ~~ITU-T Interface Rate TLV~~ (already in dissector)
- ~~ITU-T Uncertain Flag~~ (already in dissector)

I would assume that at least the gPTP 2020 change might make sense but should be a bit more backward compatible by adding more checks.

Are there example files?
I propose to close this now since all changes are merged.
